_comment: Config for pipeline_gate — the capstone that runs every PCB-flow validation gate in flow order and returns ONE go/no-go with the first blocking stage. This is the 'each stage ends in a hard pass/fail before the flow advances' spine from the master flow. Read-only: it only calls the individual read-only gates. Each gate resolves its own artifact (.kicad_sch / .kicad_pro / .kicad_pcb) from the project, so a schematic-only project passes steps 3-4 then reports the rest 'not applicable yet'. Cached; RESTART backend after edits. Verdict in words.
_rule_source: Master flow: data/config -> AI decides -> deterministic validation -> pass/fail gate -> next stage.
_mode_note: 'report' runs every gate and shows the full picture (first blocker highlighted). 'gate' stops at the first FAIL (strict advance-only-on-pass).

verdict.partial: NOT READY — {passed} gate(s) pass, {na} not applicable yet (artifact not built)
